Task: Screen every new product feature or vendor for DPDPA impact before launch
Why it matters: Catching exposure before launch is far cheaper than remediating after

Task: Log and track every Data Principal rights request against its SLA
Why it matters: Untracked requests are the most common source of missed obligations

Task: Monitor Data Protection Board guidance and finalised Rules
Why it matters: The Rules are still maturing — obligations get more concrete over time

Task: Review open remediation roadmap items with the accountable owner
Why it matters: Keeps a Gap Assessment roadmap from stalling once initial urgency fades

Task: Reconcile the Digital Personal Data Register (DPDR) against actual systems
Why it matters: Legacy fields and shadow IT accumulate quietly between reviews

Task: Review vendor risk tiering for any new or changed Data Processors
Why it matters: New vendors are a common, easily-missed compliance blind spot

Task: Report compliance posture and open risks to leadership
Why it matters: Board-level visibility is itself part of demonstrable governance

Task: Re-run or refresh your DPDP Readiness Level self-assessment
Why it matters: Tracks actual progress against the roadmap, not just completed tasks

Task: Refresh Data Processing Agreements and re-run vendor due diligence
Why it matters: Contract language and vendor risk both drift without a forced review

Task: Run a breach response tabletop exercise
Why it matters: An untested plan is the single most common gap we find in Level 3 organisations

Task: Refresh employee DPDPA training for all data-handling roles
Why it matters: Awareness decays and teams turn over — training needs a renewal cadence

Task: Review and reissue privacy notices and internal policy documents
Why it matters: Product and purpose changes routinely outpace notice content

Task: Run a DPIA-style screen before launch
Why it matters: High-risk processing needs assessment before it ships, not after

Task: Run due diligence and execute a DPDPA-aligned DPA before onboarding
Why it matters: Retrofitting a contract after data has already started flowing is much harder

Task: Classify against your breach framework within your internal target window
Why it matters: Fast, consistent triage is what makes a real notification deadline achievable

Task: Re-map cross-border data flows and localisation exposure
Why it matters: New geographies and acquired systems change your transfer risk profile
